card.name: Release checker
card.purpose: Checks a public GitHub repository for a new release and proposes a Jira ticket for it.
good_for: Tell us when a new version of a public project comes out

inputs.name: GitHub repository
inputs.what: The public repository to watch, as owner/name.

inputs.name: Jira project
inputs.what: The Jira project that gets the ticket.

blocks.say: Read the newest releases of the repository.
Look in Jira for a ticket about the newest release, so it is not raised twice.
If there is none, propose a ticket naming the release, its date and its link.

agents.part: Check LangGraph for a new release and raise a ticket.

reason: The Release checker already does this for any public repository.
questions: Which Jira project should get the ticket?
